name: O-methylnordehydrobufotenine
summary: O-Methylnordehydrobufotenine, also known as O-methyldehydrobufotenidine or as 6-methoxy-5-methyl-1,2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyrrolo[4,3,2-d,e]-quinoline, is a tricyclic cyclized tryptamine and analogue of 5-MeO-DMT and bufotenine. It produces hallucinogen-like effects in monkeys and rodents. However, although more potent than mescaline, O-methylnordehydrobufotenine was far less active than its open-chain analogue 5-MeO-DMT.

pharmacology.text: It produces hallucinogen-like effects in monkeys and rodents.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體的研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体的研究。

fact.en: Its rigid three-ring frame is the same kind of locked tryptamine skeleton found in the toad alkaloid dehydrobufotenine, where the side chain is tied back onto the indole ring.
fact.zh: 它剛性的三環骨架，與蟾蜍生物鹼去氫蟾毒色胺中那種被固定的色胺結構相同，側鏈被繫回吲哚環上。
fact.zhHans: 它刚性的三环骨架，与蟾蜍生物碱去氢蟾毒色胺中那种被固定的色胺结构相同，侧链被系回吲哚环上。
